描述_EN: the horse was frequently one of a sequence of creatures shown on ridge tiles. the ming dynasty was a flourishing period for tile production. it is a bridge to the world of spirits and a platform for them to descend to earth. it is one of the beasts of the chinese zodiac. on roofs the most common decoration was tiling. in asia, the roof, by virtue of its position on a building, is deemed a point of communication between heaven and earth. chinese builders sought to harness auspicious spiritual forces and repel evil spirits with applied ornamentation freighted with symbolic meaning.
描述_ZN: 马经常是屋脊瓦片上显示的一连串生物之一。 明朝是一个瓦片生产的繁荣时期。 它是通向精神世界的桥梁，也是他们下凡的平台。 它是中国十二生肖中的一种动物。 在屋顶上，最常见的装饰是瓦片。 在亚洲，屋顶由于其在建筑物上的位置，被认为是天与地之间的沟通点。 中国的建筑家们试图用充满象征意义的装饰品来驾驭吉祥的精神力量和驱除邪恶的灵魂。
